js.tk.org.note:
How saving works — All staged changes are sent in one batch. Either all are recorded, or none are and the refused item turns red.
  1. Make admin
  2. Delete orgs
  3. Release / update org heads & names (vacating a head first on swaps)
  4. Change lead (top-down in the new tree)
  5. Remove admin (your own removal very last)
Order is automatic so a valid final org chart never trips an intermediate conflict, cycle, or loss of admin rights.
